newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet unchanged, touch of barge activity seen.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet unchanged, touch of barge activity seen.

text.p: European jet was steady on Monday amid unchanged premiums and gas oil futures.
April IPE gas oil last traded unchanged at $170.75.
Traders said physical activity was muted with barge premiums steady. A 2,000 tonne barge was sold for first half April at April IPE gas oil +$17.50 fob ARA.
Cargoes in NWE were between April IPE gas oil +$21-24 cif NWE depending on cargo size and loading dates.
In the Mediterranean EC spec jet was hovering around fob high quotes +$8 while Libyan was in the fob high quotes +$4-5 range. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
